scope: Synthetic production collector/export/import with 30,000 native WhatsApp rows and 100 additional alias pairs. Same parameters, independent fixtures. Optional SQLite extension samples public sqlite3_db_status counters on canonical producer/importer Cache connections; native mirror and source reader connections are excluded. Disabling cache spills is experimental only and not applied to production code. Measurements are individual runs, not randomized repeated trials.

result.scope: Production collector with retained auxiliary monitoring, native preparation, canonical coverage and acknowledgement. Synthetic source has no file-backed media. Optional export includes encryption and built-in exact-ciphertext verification; import includes its trust-boundary verification. Excludes fixture setup/mutation, network transfer/remote proof, WhatsApp media and energy. Storage counters are Darwin process-attributed I/O; cached reads can be zero and buffered attribution can cross stage boundaries. RSS is the lifetime peak including fixture/baseline, not incremental-only peak. Ciphertext bytes are potential transfer bytes, not measured network traffic.
